nodes.rationale: The .run folder only adds Rider IDE support and is safe to delete when Rider is not used

nodes.label: code-reviewer agent
nodes.rationale: Checklist review across architecture, quality, testing, performance, security and docs to enforce clean architecture and Kotlin conventions.

nodes.label: college-admission-assistant agent
nodes.rationale: Main development assistant preferring Kotlin, clean architecture, DI and high test coverage for admission domains.

nodes.label: csharp-code-reviewer agent
nodes.rationale: Enforces NativeAOT-safe, cross-platform MVVM and DI patterns for Uno Platform apps.

nodes.label: documentation-writer agent
nodes.rationale: Standardizes ADRs, KDoc/Dokka, guides and changelog so docs version with code.

nodes.label: gradle-expert agent
nodes.rationale: Kotlin DSL, version catalogs, caching and parallel builds to keep multi-module builds fast and reproducible.

nodes.label: test-writer agent
nodes.rationale: JUnit5/MockK unit plus TestContainers integration with fixtures to reach high domain coverage.

nodes.label: dotnet-publish command (NativeAOT)
nodes.rationale: Publishes per-platform heads with PublishAot for release signing and distribution.
